description_expanded: PET FRIENDLY! If a vacation near the beach is your happy place, look no further than Hidden Jewel, a lovely home in Navarre! An outdoor entertainer’s dream, this spacious retreat boasts a screened-in pool, lounge chairs, a huge yard for the kids to play in, and the perfect spot to dine al fresco! Hidden Jewel is a cozy single-story home with four bedrooms and two baths accommodating up to eight. Whether you’re chilling indoors or gearing up for a beach adventure, this home sets the scene for some seriously good times! Picture yourself sinking into a huge sectional sofa after a day of soaking up the sun. Need a spot to kick back with your feet up? A chair and ottoman combo has got you covered. Movie night, anyone? Flip on the flat-screen TV and settle in for a cozy escape. Modern appliances and plenty of counter and cabinet space in the kitchen make it easy to whip up those recipes you’ve been wanting to try. A quaint little breakfast bar is a nice spot for morning coffee, while a dining table offers additional seating for meals. Of course, you could grill out by the pool and eat outside while the kids are having the time of their lives splashing and playing. Bedrooms feature cozy linens and are the perfect place to unwind after days spent exploring the beauty of Navarre. With a king, 2 Queen, and two twin beds, everyone is assured a peaceful and relaxing stay. A full-sized washer and dryer makes cleanups quick and easy so you can get back to relaxing! With the perfect setup in the backyard, you may just want to hang out by the pool, but be sure to explore all the fun to be had in Navarre. You’ll find quaint shops downtown, plenty of restaurants, and the beach just minutes away. For delicious seafood, try Juana’s Pagodas or Dewey Destin’s, then cast your line at the Navarre Beach Fishing Pier. Learn about our local sea turtles at the Navarre Beach Sea Turtle Conservation Center, and the whole family will enjoy a visit to the Gulf Breeze Zoo! Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. The property boasts a beautiful private pool along with an outdoor shower. The property allows one dog under 40 pounds and the non-refundable pet fee is an additional $300 fee. Please note: This property has a regulated thermostat, and will not go below 69°.
